_readme: TUTORIAL HUB (Arthur's tutorial binder): the tabs and the drill cards. Edit freely; changes apply on the next Play.
Full reference: Documentation/TrainingHub/README.md. Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored.
tabs: the divider tabs on the binder, top to bottom. alwaysOpen = the tab and all its cards are open from the first launch (Basics).
Any other tab stays hidden until one of its cards is open.
cards: tab = the tab id. number = the big handwritten number. skills = the short lines on the card.
lessons = the in-game lessons this card covers, as Level_01/<guide.json lesson id>. A card that is not in an alwaysOpen tab opens
once the player has FINISHED one of these lessons in the level (or already completed that chapter). A lesson belongs to one card only.
drill = the practice file in Resources/Tutorials/Training/Drills (without .json). lockedNote = the note on a locked card (no spoilers).
greetings: the guide's line on the left page; one is picked at random.
title: TUTORIAL BINDER
greetings: Back for a refresher, rookie? Pick a drill and show me what you've got!
Practice here is free. Nobody's watching the clock but you.
Do it once with my help, then once on your own. That's how it sticks!
